title: Reconnect back-off: escalation tiers by attempt density in the reference product, plain doubling in ours (G-11-2)
reference_behaviour: The reconnect delay escalates by how many attempts happened recently (tiers at 4 attempts in 10 s, 8 in 30 s, 15 in 60 s), capped at 30 s, and retries every 5 s while the device reports offline (bundle-findings 6.1).
ours: SPEC CHANGE: REQ-114 AC-3 (approved) waits 1 s, 2 s, 4 s and so on, plain doubling capped at 30 s, with no attempt-density tiers.
